class Temp {
  private _c = 0;
  get celsius(): number {
    return this._c;
  }
  set celsius(v: number) {
    if (v < -273.15) throw new RangeError("too cold");
    this._c = v;
  }
  get fahrenheit() {
    return (this._c * 9) / 5 + 32;
  }
}
const tt = new Temp();
tt.celsius = 25;
console.log(tt.celsius, tt.fahrenheit);
interface Shape {
  area(): number;
  perimeter?(): number;
}
class Sq implements Shape {
  constructor(private s: number) {}
  area() {
    return this.s ** 2;
  }
}
const shapes: Shape[] = [new Sq(2), { area: () => 1, perimeter: () => 4 }];
console.log(shapes.map((s) => [s.area(), s.perimeter?.() ?? -1]));
class Registry<T extends { id: number }> {
  private items = new Map<number, T>();
  add(item: T): void {
    this.items.set(item.id, item);
  }
  find(id: number): T | undefined {
    return this.items.get(id);
  }
  all(): T[] {
    return [...this.items.values()];
  }
}
const reg = new Registry<{ id: number; name: string }>();
reg.add({ id: 1, name: "a" });
console.log(reg.find(1)?.name, reg.find(2), reg.all().length);
class Counter {
  static instances = 0;
  readonly id: number;
  constructor() {
    Counter.instances++;
    this.id = Counter.instances;
  }
}
new Counter();
const c2 = new Counter();
console.log(c2.id, Counter.instances);
function isString(v: unknown): v is string {
  return typeof v === "string";
}
const inputs: unknown[] = ["a", 1, "b", null];
const strs = inputs.filter(isString).map((s) => s.toUpperCase());
console.log(strs);
type Handler = (event: { type: string; payload?: number }) => void;
const handlers: Record<string, Handler[]> = {};
function on(type: string, h: Handler): void {
  (handlers[type] ??= []).push(h);
}
on("x", (e) => console.log(e.type, e.payload ?? 0));
for (const h of handlers["x"] ?? []) h({ type: "x", payload: 5 });
class Base {
  greet(): string {
    return "base";
  }
}
class Child extends Base {
  greet(): string {
    return `child of ${super.greet()}`;
  }
}
const items: Base[] = [new Base(), new Child()];
for (const it of items) console.log(it.greet(), it instanceof Child);
const point = { x: 1, y: 2 };
const { x, ...others } = point;
const copy = { ...point, z: 3 };
console.log(x, others, copy);
let total = 0;
[1, 2, 3].forEach((n) => {
  total += n;
});
console.log(total);
